01 The idea

TAFES needed to register new students at the start of the year and then actually reach them. The public form takes a minute on a phone. The admin dashboard filters people by level, course, hostel, talent and date, and exports the list for SMS campaigns.

  • 1minute to register on a phone
  • 7filters that combine
  • 9digits typed, saved as +255
  • 10talents per person

02 What it does

01

A form that respects the phone

Only the nine digits after +255 are asked for. Numbers pasted with 0 or +255 are trimmed automatically.

02

Duplicate check that leaks nothing

Once the number is typed, the form checks whether it is already registered and answers only yes or no.

03

Talents and where people stay

Pick talents or type new ones, and give a hostel room or a place outside campus.

04

Filters that combine

Search, level, course, hostel, status, date range and talents, all at once.

05

CSV export for SMS

Export the list with status and how many messages each person has received.

06

Courses from the source

The course list comes from Arusha Technical College's own programmes API.

03 On the screen

04 Under the hood

For the technical reader: how it is put together.

  • Next.js 16
  • TypeScript
  • Tailwind CSS 4
  • Prisma
  • PostgreSQL
  • Vercel
  1. Next.js App Router on Vercel, with migrations applied on every build.
  2. Prisma with PostgreSQL on Neon. Numbers stored in the format Beem Africa SMS expects.
  3. Admin sessions in an HMAC-signed cookie, with no third-party auth.
  4. Zod validation shared by the form and the API.
